description: This file defines an abstract class 'MaterialsProviderV2' which implements 'MaterialsProviderInterfaceV2'. It provides methods related to cryptographic key management, including checking supported key sizes, generating IVs, and abstract methods for key wrapping and unwrapping. The class appears to serve as a base for crypto material providers within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: MaterialsProviderV2
classes.description: An abstract cryptographic materials provider class for AWS SDK, implementing key size validation, IV generation, and defining core cryptographic methods.

methods.name: isSupportedKeySize
methods.description: Checks if a given key size (in bits) is supported (128 or 256 bits).

methods.name: getWrapAlgorithmName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the wrap algorithm name.

methods.name: decryptCek
methods.description: Abstract method to decrypt an encrypted Content Encryption Key (CEK) using provider-specific logic.

methods.name: generateCek
methods.description: Abstract method to generate a new CEK with specified key size and context.

methods.name: generateIv
methods.description: Generates a random initialization vector (IV) for encryption/decryption.
